$comment: Shared project settings for the Claude Code dev-team bundle. Command-level Bash permissions are project-global in Claude Code (they cannot be scoped per-agent the way OpenCode did). Per-agent capability is controlled by each agent's tools: allowlist in .claude/agents/*.md. Both MCP servers are disabled by default — remove from disabledMcpjsonServers to enable for the dev phase. outputStyle defaults the main session to the Engineering Lead orchestrator persona.
